words.description: Word-level text and timings. A word can carry ``, `` and `` styling tags (for example `really`).

text.description: Human-readable mirror of the segment text. `words` is the source of truth.

metadata.description: Review state and per-segment dubbing settings

cue_settings.description: Position of this segment's subtitle on the video. Absent when the subtitle profile position is used.

style.description: Optional style of this segment's subtitle, overriding the subtitle profile (font, size, colors, background, position). Omit it to use the subtitle profile; a segment sent without `style` loses the style it had.

comments.description: Reviewer comments of the segment. Absent when the segment has none.
